# Nygen Docs

> Documentation for the open-source single-cell biology tools built by Nygen Analytics, an applied AI lab in Lund, Sweden. CyteArc analyses single-cell RNA, ATAC, protein, and multi-omic data out of core, up to 100M+ cells. CyteBase publishes public single-cell datasets as cloud-hosted CyteArc DataStores. CyteType (Python) and CyteTypeR (R) annotate cell types with evidence and Cell Ontology IDs. CyteOnto compares cell type labels in Cell Ontology space.

CyteArc and CyteBase publish their own llms.txt files, which link to plain-text versions of every documentation page. The other projects link to their main documentation or README.

## Projects

- [CyteArc](https://docs.nygen.io/CyteArc/llms.txt): out-of-core single-cell analysis in Python for RNA, ATAC, protein, and multi-omic data, with provenance on every result. Install with `pip install cytearc`.
- [CyteBase](https://docs.nygen.io/CyteBase/llms.txt): searchable catalog of public single-cell datasets from CZ CELLxGENE Discover, published as cloud-hosted CyteArc DataStores that open and mount without downloading. Install with `pip install cytebase`.
- [CyteType](https://www.nygen.io/docs/cytetype): evidence-backed cell type annotation for Scanpy and AnnData. Returns cell type, Cell Ontology ID, confidence, and an HTML report per cluster. Install with `pip install cytetype`.
- [CyteTypeR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NygenAnalytics/CyteTypeR/master/README.md): the CyteType workflow for Seurat objects in R. Install with `devtools::install_github("NygenAnalytics/CyteTypeR")`.
- [CyteOnto](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NygenAnalytics/CyteOnto/master/README.md): semantic comparison of cell type labels against the Cell Ontology, for benchmarking annotation methods. Hosted API at https://cyteonto.nygen.io with no key required.

## Optional

- [CyteType preprint](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2025.11.06.686964v1): Multi-agent AI enables evidence-based cell annotation in single-cell transcriptomics. bioRxiv, 2025.
- [CyteType README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NygenAnalytics/CyteType/master/README.md): quick start and configuration for the Python client.
- [Source code](https://github.com/NygenAnalytics): all public Nygen repositories on GitHub.
- [Nygen Analytics](https://www.nygen.io/): company website.
